customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (one profile per borrower or per dealership business)

customer_type.meaning: individual = a retail borrower or co-borrower; dealer = a franchised or independent dealership business that sells contracts to the company

name.meaning: full legal name of the individual, or the dealership's legal business name, exactly as on file

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on file; usable to look the profile up and as a verification credential

email.meaning: email address on file, lower case; usable to look the profile up and as a verification credential

tax_id_last4.meaning: last four digits of the individual's Social Security number, or of the dealership's Employer Identification Number; a verification credential

date_of_birth.meaning: individual's date of birth (a verification credential); empty for a dealer

zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address on file; a verification credential

mailing_address.meaning: full mailing address on file, used for notices, refund checks and mailed titles

state_code.format: two-letter USPS state code, upper case (e.g. TX)
state_code.meaning: state of the mailing address on file (residence for an individual, place of business for a dealer)

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the customer profile was created

scra_active_duty_start_date.meaning: start date of the individual's current or most recent period of military service verified through the Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC) or orders on file; empty if none

scra_active_duty_end_date.meaning: end date of that period of military service; empty while service is continuing or when no service is on file

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record (one per customer)

customer_id.meaning: customer whose identity was checked (-> customers)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; never changes from true back to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

customer_id.meaning: customer handed to a human representative (-> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

contract_id.meaning: primary id of the retail installment contract

dealer_agreement_id.meaning: the selling dealer's agreement under which the company purchased the contract (-> dealer_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: credit tier assigned at purchase, written as the official tier name; never changes after booking

status.meaning: contract lifecycle status: pending_funding = booked, dealer not yet funded; active = in servicing (current or delinquent); repossessed = vehicle recovered and held; paid_off = satisfied in full; liquidated = vehicle sold after repossession; charged_off = charged off without repossession, balance still owed; unwound = cancelled before funding

account_number.meaning: account number printed on the borrower's statements; the borrower may quote it

contract_date.meaning: date the borrower signed the contract

first_payment_date.meaning: due date of the first scheduled installment

maturity_date.meaning: due date of the final scheduled installment after every extension and due-date change

term_months.meaning: number of scheduled monthly installments at signing

amount_financed_usd.meaning: amount financed disclosed in the Truth in Lending box at signing

original_apr_pct.meaning: annual percentage rate disclosed at signing

apr_pct.meaning: simple-interest rate currently charged; equals original_apr_pct unless the SCRA rate cap is in effect

scheduled_payment_usd.meaning: current scheduled monthly installment (interest plus principal)

due_day.meaning: day of the month on which installments fall due

next_due_date.meaning: due date of the earliest installment not yet fully paid, after extensions and due-date changes; the contract is past due when this date is earlier than today

partial_installment_credit_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 or more and less than scheduled_payment_usd
partial_installment_credit_usd.meaning: installment credit already received toward the installment due on next_due_date

unpaid_interest_usd.meaning: accrued interest that the latest payments did not cover, carried into the next interest calculation; 0.00 when every payment has covered its interest

principal_balance_usd.meaning: unpaid principal; the running sum of the principal_balance account (excludes accrued interest and fees)

fees_due_usd.meaning: assessed and unpaid contract fees; the running sum of the fees_due account

certified_funds_only.meaning: true while the contract is restricted to certified-funds payment channels after repeated returned payments

vehicle_year.meaning: model year of the financed vehicle

vehicle_description.meaning: make, model and trim of the financed vehicle as printed on the contract

vehicle_book_value_usd.meaning: wholesale book value of the vehicle used for loan-to-value at origination

harborline_score.meaning: Harborline custom credit score at origination

state_code.format: two-letter USPS state code, upper case (e.g. TX)
state_code.meaning: contract state: the borrower's state at signing, whose law governs the contract

title_state_code.format: two-letter USPS state code, upper case (e.g. TX)
title_state_code.meaning: state that issued the vehicle title naming the company as lienholder

repossession_date.meaning: date of the most recent recovery of the vehicle; empty if never repossessed

closed_date.meaning: date the contract left servicing (paid off, liquidated, charged off or unwound); empty while pending_funding, active or repossessed

payoff_reason.meaning: how a paid_off contract was satisfied: borrower_payoff = payoff funds from the borrower or a refinancing lender; total_loss_settlement = insurance settlement plus GAP benefit; redemption = redeemed after repossession; not_paid_off for any other status

contract_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the contract ledger row

amount_usd.meaning: magnitude of the row; whether it raises or lowers a balance is fixed by event_type, never by a sign

payment_channel.meaning: channel of a payment or of the returned payment; ach_autopay = recurring ACH; *_self_service = automated phone line, website or app; *_agent = taken by a live representative; third_party_remittance = insurer, auction or other third-party funds; not_applicable on non-payment rows

payment_type.meaning: what a posted payment was for; not_applicable on non-payment rows

interest_applied_usd.meaning: interest portion of a payment, or the interest portion reversed by a return; 0.00 on other rows

principal_applied_usd.meaning: principal portion of a payment (installment plus additional principal), reversed by a return, or moved by a balance transfer; 0.00 on other rows

fees_applied_usd.meaning: fee portion of a payment, reversed by a return, or moved by a balance transfer; 0.00 on other rows

fee_type.meaning: kind of fee on a contract_fee_assessed row; not_applicable on other rows

installment_due_date.meaning: for a late charge, the due date of the installment it is charged on; empty otherwise

related_txn_id.meaning: the row this row acts on: the returned payment (return), the return/payment/extension record a fee is charged for, the fee being waived, the payment or transfer settling fees; empty when none

return_reason.meaning: bank return reason on a returned payment; not_applicable on other rows

waiver_reason.meaning: reason on a fee waiver; not_applicable on other rows

ancillary_source.meaning: originating product charge or credit on an ancillary row; not_applicable on other rows

source_record_id.meaning: on an ancillary row, the originating record in the other product (CPI, GAP or service-contract activity, or the SCRA servicing record); on a balance transfer, the receiving deficiency account; empty otherwise

fee_settlement_method.meaning: how fees were settled on a contract_fee_paid row; not_applicable on other rows

servicing_event_id.meaning: primary id of the contract servicing record

effective_date.meaning: date the action took effect (change date, extension date, rate effective date, quote date or lien release date)

service_request_id.meaning: the signed request behind an extension or SCRA rate-cap action (-> contract_service_requests); empty otherwise

old_due_day.meaning: due day before a due-date change

new_due_day.meaning: due day after a due-date change

old_next_due_date.meaning: next due date before a due-date change or extension

new_next_due_date.meaning: next due date after a due-date change or extension

extension_months.format: integer count of installments, 0 when not applicable

new_maturity_date.meaning: final installment date after a due-date change or extension

fee_treatment.meaning: whether an extension carried its fee; not_applicable on other rows

scra_action.meaning: SCRA rate-cap action; not_applicable on other rows

new_apr_pct.format: percent, 2 decimal places, or 0.00 when not applicable
new_apr_pct.meaning: rate charged from the effective date of an SCRA action

new_scheduled_payment_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
new_scheduled_payment_usd.meaning: installment amount from the effective date of an SCRA action

quoted_payoff_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable

quote_good_through_date.meaning: last date the quoted payoff amount is valid

funds_final_date.meaning: date payoff funds became final, on a lien release

release_method.meaning: how the lien was released; not_applicable on other rows

service_request_id.meaning: primary id of the borrower's servicing request

contract_id.meaning: the contract the request is for (-> contracts)

request_type.meaning: extension = extension agreement sent for signature; scra_rate_cap = written SCRA rate-cap request with orders

requested_extension_months.format: integer count of installments, 0 when not applicable

request_status.meaning: pending_signature = sent, awaiting the borrower's signature; signed = signed by the borrower; applied = carried out; lapsed = not signed in time; withdrawn = cancelled by the borrower

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

signed_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now(), or empty string
signed_at.meaning: moment the borrower signed; empty until signed

cpi_coverage_id.meaning: primary id of the insurance tracking record (one open record per contract)

variant_name.meaning: collateral protection plan band for the vehicle's value, written as the official plan name

status.meaning: tracking status: pending_verification = new contract, proof not yet verified; compliant = acceptable borrower insurance on file; lapse_notice = coverage lapsed, notices running; force_placed = collateral protection insurance placed and billing; closed = contract left active servicing

vehicle_acv_usd.meaning: vehicle value that set the current plan band (at opening, then at placement)

insurer_name.meaning: insurer on the latest accepted proof; empty if none accepted

policy_number.meaning: policy or binder number on the latest accepted proof; empty if none accepted

policy_expiration_date.meaning: expiration date on the latest accepted proof

lapse_date.meaning: first day without acceptable borrower coverage in the current lapse; empty when not in lapse

placement_effective_date.meaning: date the current placed coverage started; empty when not force_placed

premium_billed_usd.meaning: net premium charged on this record; the running sum of the cpi_premium_net account

closed_date.meaning: date tracking ended; empty while open

cpi_activity_id.meaning: primary id of the tracking activity row

activity_date.meaning: date of the review, mailing, billing or refund

insurer_name.meaning: insurer named on a reviewed proof; empty on other rows

policy_number.meaning: policy or binder number on a reviewed proof; empty on other rows

policy_effective_date.meaning: start of the coverage shown on a reviewed proof

policy_expiration_date.meaning: end of the coverage shown on a reviewed proof

comprehensive_deductible_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
comprehensive_deductible_usd.meaning: comprehensive deductible shown on a reviewed proof

collision_deductible_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
collision_deductible_usd.meaning: collision deductible shown on a reviewed proof

lienholder_listed.meaning: whether a reviewed proof lists the company as lienholder and loss payee; false on other rows

verification_source.meaning: channel through which a proof arrived; not_applicable on other rows

proof_result.meaning: outcome of a proof review; not_applicable on other rows

notice_type.meaning: notice mailed; not_applicable on other rows

billing_period_start.meaning: first day of a billed premium period

billing_period_end.meaning: last day of a billed premium period

amount_usd.meaning: premium billed or refunded; 0.00 on review and notice rows

billing_method.meaning: added_to_contract_balance = premium capitalised on the contract; held_pending_proof_review = premium recorded but held off the contract while borrower proof is reviewed; not_applicable on other rows

related_activity_id.meaning: on a refund, the premium charge row being refunded; empty otherwise

refund_basis.meaning: how a refund was determined; not_applicable on other rows

refund_disposition.meaning: where a refund went; not_billed_release = a held premium released without money moving; not_applicable on other rows

recovery_case_id.meaning: primary id of the repossession case (one per default episode of a contract)

variant_name.meaning: collateral class of the financed vehicle, written as the official recovery class name; sets the recovery expense schedule

status.meaning: case status: pre_repo_review = referred, conditions for assignment being checked; assigned = with a recovery agency; recovered = vehicle held by the company; reinstated / redeemed / sold / recalled = closed outcomes

recovery_method.meaning: how the vehicle comes into the company's possession

assigned_date.meaning: date the case was assigned to an agency; empty before assignment

agency_name.meaning: licensed recovery agency assigned; empty before assignment

recovery_date.meaning: date the vehicle came into the company's possession; empty before recovery

storage_lot.meaning: storage lot holding the vehicle; empty before recovery

keys_obtained.meaning: whether a key came in with the vehicle; false before recovery

personal_property_found.meaning: whether personal property was inventoried in the vehicle at recovery

sale_date.meaning: date the vehicle was sold; empty unless sold

net_proceeds_applied_usd.meaning: proceeds applied to the contract after recovery expenses

sale_result.meaning: whether a deficiency, a surplus or neither remained after the sale; not_sold until sold

recall_reason.meaning: why the case closed without recovery; not_recalled otherwise

expenses_outstanding_usd.meaning: posted and unsettled recovery expenses; the running sum of the recovery_expenses account (storage not yet posted is excluded)

closed_date.meaning: date the case closed (reinstated, redeemed, sold or recalled); empty while open

recovery_activity_id.meaning: primary id of the recovery activity row

activity_date.meaning: date of the mailing, posting, quote, payment or release

notice_type.meaning: notice mailed; not_applicable on other rows

delivery_method.meaning: how a notice was mailed; not_applicable on other rows

deadline_date.meaning: cure deadline, earliest sale date, property claim deadline, or a quote's good-through date

stated_amount_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
stated_amount_usd.meaning: amount stated in a notice or quote (cure amount, reinstatement amount, surplus or deficiency)

expense_type.meaning: kind of recovery expense; not_applicable on other rows

amount_usd.meaning: expense posted, removed or settled, or surplus paid; 0.00 on notice and quote rows

chargeable_days.format: integer count of days, 0 when not applicable
chargeable_days.meaning: storage days charged on a storage_fee row

related_activity_id.meaning: on an expense removal, the expense row removed; empty otherwise

waiver_reason.meaning: reason an expense was removed; not_applicable on other rows

settlement_method.meaning: how expenses were settled; not_applicable on other rows

past_due_installments_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
past_due_installments_usd.meaning: installment portion of a reinstatement quote

late_charges_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
late_charges_usd.meaning: contract fee portion of a reinstatement quote

expenses_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
expenses_usd.meaning: recovery expense portion of a reinstatement quote, including storage accrued to the good-through date

property_disposition.meaning: what happened to personal property; not_applicable on other rows

deficiency_account_id.meaning: primary id of the deficiency account (one per liquidated contract with a deficiency)

recovery_case_id.meaning: the recovery case whose sale produced the deficiency (-> recovery_cases)

variant_name.meaning: resolution band set by original_deficiency_usd, written as the official band name; never changes

status.meaning: account status: open = balance owed, no arrangement in force; on_payment_plan / on_settlement_plan = accepted arrangement in force; paid_in_full / settled = closed; referred_to_agency = placed with an outside collection agency

deficiency_balance_usd.meaning: amount still owed; the running sum of the deficiency_balance account (no interest or fees ever accrue)

arrangement_offer_id.meaning: the accepted plan or settlement offer in force (-> deficiency_arrangement_offers); empty when none

last_payment_date.meaning: date of the latest posted payment that was not returned; empty if none

referred_date.meaning: date the account was placed with a collection agency; empty otherwise

closed_date.meaning: date the account was paid in full or settled; empty otherwise

deficiency_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the deficiency ledger row

amount_usd.meaning: magnitude of the row; whether it raises or lowers the balance is fixed by event_type

payment_channel.meaning: channel of a payment or of the returned payment; not_applicable on other rows

arrangement_offer_id.meaning: the accepted arrangement a payment counts toward, or the settlement a waiver completes; empty otherwise

related_txn_id.meaning: on a return, the payment returned; empty otherwise

return_reason.meaning: bank return reason; not_applicable on other rows

credit_source.meaning: origin of a credit; not_applicable on other rows

source_record_id.meaning: on a credit, the originating refund or correction record in the other product; empty otherwise

form_1099c_required.meaning: on a settlement waiver, whether the forgiven amount is reported on IRS Form 1099-C; false on other rows

arrangement_offer_id.meaning: primary id of the plan or settlement offer

deficiency_account_id.meaning: the account the offer covers (-> deficiency_accounts)

offer_amount_usd.meaning: total the borrower pays under the offer (the balance for a plan, the settlement amount for a settlement)

installment_count.format: integer count, 1 for a lump sum

installment_amount_usd.meaning: amount of each installment (the last installment of a plan may be smaller)

first_due_date.meaning: due date of the first installment or of the lump sum

down_payment_usd.meaning: down payment required to start a plan after a broken arrangement

hardship_document.meaning: hardship document on file supporting a hardship settlement; none otherwise

offer_status.meaning: offered = awaiting the borrower's answer; accepted = accepted by the borrower; declined / expired = not taken; broken = an installment went unpaid past grace; completed = fully paid

accepted_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now(), or empty string
accepted_at.meaning: moment the borrower accepted; empty until accepted

broken_date.meaning: date the arrangement was broken; empty otherwise

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

gap_addendum_id.meaning: primary id of the GAP waiver addendum

contract_id.meaning: the contract the addendum is attached to (-> contracts)

variant_name.meaning: addendum plan, written as the official plan name

status.meaning: addendum status: active = in force; claim_open = loss under review; benefit_paid = benefit credited, ended; cancelled = ended before expiration (including a denied claim); expired = reached its expiration date

enrollment_date.meaning: date the addendum was bought (the contract date)

price_usd.meaning: charge for the addendum financed in the contract

expiration_date.meaning: last day of coverage (the contract's original maturity date)

charge_net_usd.meaning: charge net of refunds; the running sum of the gap_charge_net account

cancellation_reason.meaning: why the addendum was cancelled; not_cancelled otherwise

cancellation_effective_date.meaning: effective date of the cancellation; empty unless cancelled

closed_date.meaning: date the addendum ended (cancellation processing, benefit decision or expiration); empty while active or claim_open

gap_activity_id.meaning: primary id of the GAP activity row

activity_date.meaning: date the claim was reported, decided or the refund issued

loss_date.meaning: date of the loss on a claim; empty on other rows

loss_type.meaning: kind of loss on a claim; not_applicable on other rows

primary_insurer_name.meaning: borrower's insurer on a claim; empty on other rows

primary_settlement_acv_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
primary_settlement_acv_usd.meaning: actual cash value set by the primary insurer, before its deductible

primary_deductible_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
primary_deductible_usd.meaning: deductible the primary insurer deducted from its settlement

related_activity_id.meaning: on a decision, the claim row decided; empty otherwise

decision.meaning: claim decision; not_applicable on other rows

denial_reason.meaning: reason for a denial; not_applicable otherwise

balance_at_loss_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
balance_at_loss_usd.meaning: scheduled balance on the date of loss used for the benefit

excluded_amounts_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
excluded_amounts_usd.meaning: total of excluded amounts deducted from the benefit

deductible_covered_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable
deductible_covered_usd.meaning: primary deductible covered by the benefit

benefit_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when not applicable or denied

amount_usd.meaning: refund amount on a refund row; 0.00 on other rows

refund_method.meaning: how a refund was computed; not_applicable on other rows

refund_disposition.meaning: where a refund went; not_applicable on other rows

gap_request_id.meaning: on a refund for a voluntary cancellation, the signed request (-> gap_cancellation_requests); empty otherwise
primary id of the borrower's GAP cancellation request

signed_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now(), or empty string

expiration_odometer.meaning: odometer_at_sale plus the plan's term miles

price_net_usd.meaning: price net of refunds; the running sum of the vsc_price_net account

cancellation_reason.meaning: why the service contract was cancelled; not_cancelled otherwise

cancellation_odometer.meaning: odometer at the cancellation effective date

closed_date.meaning: date the service contract ended; empty while active

vsc_activity_id.meaning: primary id of the service-contract activity row

activity_date.meaning: date of the authorization, denial or refund

repair_order_number.meaning: repair facility's repair order number on a claim; empty on refunds

repair_facility.meaning: repair facility name on a claim; empty on refunds

component_group.meaning: component group claimed; not_applicable on refunds

odometer_at_request.meaning: odometer the borrower certifies on the request
